description: The pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," illustrates the breakdown of token resolution methods used in the FedHLM framework, as described in the paper "Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Models for Communication-Efficient Token Transmission." The chart displays three distinct categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The largest segment, colored green, represents the LOCAL method, accounting for 94.5% of the token distribution. The red segment, labeled LLM, constitutes 3.9% of the total, while the blue segment, labeled EDGE_P2P, makes up 1.6%. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the LOCAL slice dominating the chart. Each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding category and percentage value, and the chart visually emphasizes the overwhelming prevalence of local token resolution compared to the hybrid P2P and LLM-based approaches.
